title: Uruguayan-Style Grilled Chorizo Casserole
description: A South American-inspired casserole featuring chorizo, cucumber, and a hint of garlic. Perfect for a quick and flavorful dinner.

ingredients.name: Light casserole
ingredients.notes: Do not prepare according to box instructions

instructions: Season chorizo slices with salt and pepper.
Brush chorizo slices with olive oil.
Grill chorizo for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add sliced cucumber to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly tender.
In a large bowl, combine cooked chorizo, cucumber mixture, and light casserole.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake at 375°F for 15-20 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with additional sliced cucumber if desired.
